summary: Sabine County lookout the association's county list marks gone, with unknown type; its inventory dates it 1934 to about 1938. No site description found.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone. No source describes what, if anything, remains at the site.

events.note: Inventory date column reads 1934, read here as the build year.
Inventory removal column reads c1938, an approximate year.

evidence.supports: Geneva listed in Sabine County, type unknown, status gone
Inventory row: date 1934, removal c1938, manufacturer and height unknown

notes_for_editor: Only two list entries exist and neither has narrative text, so the story is short on purpose. Record location matches the county list. A 1938 Forest Service photo of a Milam CCC foreman spiking a pine for a fire lookout (SFASU archive) does not name Geneva, so it is left out.
